59200.meaning1: love for ascetics; fondness for monastics

examples.text: mayañ'hi, bho gotama, pubbe evaṃ jānāma, ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupād'āpaccā, ke ca dhammassa aññātāro'ti? ajanesi vata me bhavaṃ gotamo samaṇesu samaṇapemaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇapasādaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.

59201.meaning1: confidence in ascetics; faith in monks

examples.text: ajanesi vata me, bhante, bhagavā samaṇesu samaṇappemaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇappasādaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.

59202.meaning1: pronouncement of an ascetic; utterance of a monk

examples.text: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi, samaṇappavādasitāni bhūripañña, saññ'akkharasaññanissitāni, osaraṇāni vineyya oghatam'agā.

59203.meaning1: love for ascetics (in); affection for monks

examples.text: ajanesi vata me, bhante, bhagavā samaṇesu samaṇappemaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇappasādaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.

59204.meaning1: ascetic or Brahman; monk or priest

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgatesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mah'ānisaṃsaṃ na mahājutikaṃ na mahāvipphāraṃ. kathaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgatesu?

59205.meaning1: ascetics, priests, tramps, paupers and beggars
59205.meaning2: ascetics, priests, tramps, paupers and beggars
59205.constructionSummary: samaṇa + brāhmaṇa + kapaṇa + addhika + vaṇibbaka + yācakā
59205.construction: samaṇa + brāhmaṇa + kapaṇa + addhika + vaṇibbaka + yācakā
59205.compound: dvanda (samaṇa ca brāhmaṇa ca kapaṇa ca addhika ca vaṇibbaka ca yācakā)
59205.commentary: (DNa) ettha samitapāpā samaṇā, bāhitapāpā brāhmaṇā. kapaṇā'ti duggatā daliddamanussā. addhikā'ti pathāvino. vaṇibbakā'ti ye, iṭṭhaṃ dinnaṃ, kantaṃ, manāpaṃ, kālena anavajjaṃ dinnaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyya, gacchatu bhavaṃ brahmalokan'ti-ādinā nayena dānassa vaṇṇaṃ thomayamānā vicaranti. yācakā'ti ye, pasatamattaṃ detha, sarāvamattaṃ dethā'ti-ādīni vatvā yācamānā vicaranti.
59205.sanskrit: śramaṇa + brāhmaṇa + kṛpaṇa + adhvagat + vanīpaka, vanīyaka + yācaka

examples.text: rājā mahāvijito… saddho dāyako dānapati anāvaṭadvāro samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vaṇibbaka-yācakānaṃ opānabhūto puññāni karoti

59206.meaning1: ascetics, priests, tramps, homeless wanderers and beggars
59206.constructionSummary: samaṇa + brāhmaṇa + kapaṇa + addhika + vanibbaka + yācaka + ā
59206.construction:
samaṇa + brāhmaṇa + kapaṇa + addhika + vanibbaka + yācaka + ā
samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavanibbakayācaka + ā
59206.compound: dvanda (samaṇa ca brāhmaṇa ca kapaṇa ca addhika ca vanibbaka ca yācakā)
59206.commentary: (SNa) samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānan'ti ettha samaṇā'ti pabbajj'ūpagatā. brāhmaṇā'ti bhovādino. samitapāpabāhitapāpe pana samaṇabrāhmaṇe esa n'ālattha. kapaṇā'ti duggatā daliddamanussā kāṇakuṇiādayo. addhikā'ti pathāvino. vanibbakā'ti ye, iṭṭhaṃ, dinnaṃ, kantaṃ, manāpaṃ, kālena, anavajjaṃ dinnaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyya, gacchatu bhavaṃ brahmalokan'ti-ādinā nayena dānassa vaṇṇaṃ thomayamānā vicaranti. yācakā'ti ye, pasatamattaṃ detha, sarāvamattaṃ dethā'tiādīni ca vatvā yācamānā vicaranti.
59206.sanskrit: śramaṇa + brāhmaṇa + kṛpaṇa + adhvagat + vanīyaka + yācaka

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ.

59207.construction:
samaṇa + brāhmaṇa + paribbājaka + ā
samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājaka + ā
59207.compound: dvanda (samaṇā ca brāhmaṇā ca paribbājakā ca)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gāmaṇi, yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ ūsaraṃ pāpabhūmi, evam'eva mayhaṃ aññatitthiyā samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakā.

59214.meaning2: Chapter 8 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

59215.meaning1: ascetics and Brahmans; monks and priests

examples.text: sant'āvuso, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.

n'āhaṃ sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, jātijarāya nivutā'ti brūmi, ye s'īdha diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, anekarūpam'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, taṇhaṃ pariññāya anāsavāse, te ve narā oghatiṇṇā'ti brūmi.

59216.meaning1: cared for by ascetics and Brahmans; treated with compassion by monks and priests

examples.text: tam'enaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇā sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīgham'āyuṃ pālehī'ti. samaṇa-brāhmaṇ'ānukampitassa, mahānāma, kulaputtassa vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

59217.meaning1: time of a meal offered by an ascetic; occasion of an ascetic's food offering
59217.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.2) samaṇabhattasamayo nāma yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno bhattaṃ karoti. samaṇabhattasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ. (KVa) yadā yokoci pabbajito bhattena nimanteti, ayaṃ samaṇabhattasamayo

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāv'ābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
kalyāṇadassano bhikkhu, kañcanasannibhattaco, kiṃ te samaṇabhāvena, evaṃ uttamavaṇṇino.

59219.meaning1: stable ascetic; epithet of a stream-enterer
59219.commentary: (DNa) samaṇam'acalo'ti samaṇa-acalo. ma-kāro padasandhimattaṃ. so sot'āpanno veditabbo. sot'āpanno hi catūhi vātehi indakhīlo viya parappavādehi akampiyo. acalasaddhāya samannāgato'ti samaṇam'acalo. vuttam'pi c'etaṃ, katamo ca puggalo samaṇam'acalo? idh'ekacco puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā'ti (pu. pa. 190) vitthāro.

examples.text: apare'pi cattāro puggalā, samaṇam'acalo, samaṇapadumo, samaṇapuṇḍarīko, samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo.

59220.commentary: (DNt) so dhammo ca lok'uttaro'va adhippeto, yena saṃsārato visujjhati, tasmā samaṇamaṇḍalan'ti ca sāsanikam'eva samaṇagaṇaṃ vadatī'ti daṭṭhabbaṃ. ten'āha samaṇamaṇḍalañ'hī'ti-ādi.

examples.text: suddo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, samaṇo bhavissāmī'ti. imehi kho, vāseṭṭha, catūhi maṇḍalehi samaṇamaṇḍalassa abhinibbatti ahosi, tesaṃ'y'eva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ, sadisānaṃ'y'eva no asadisānaṃ, dhammen'eva no adhammena.
tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamaṇḍikāputto samayappavādake tinduk'ācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.

59222.meaning1: stain of an ascetic; impurity of a renunciant
59222.commentary: (MNa) ete dhammā uppajjamānā samaṇe maline karonti malaggahite, tasmā samaṇamalā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.
tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto samayappavādake tinduk'ācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.

59225.meaning1: we are ascetics; we are monks

examples.text: mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.
pasannanetto sumukho, brahā uju patāpavā, majjhe samaṇasaṅghassa, ādicco'va virocasi.

59230.commentary: (PMa) samaṇesū'ti samitapāpesu. samaṇasammatā'ti na mayā samaṇā'ti sammatā. sammatā'ti vattamānakālavasena vuccamāne saddalakkhaṇavasena me'ti ettha sāmivacanam'eva hoti.

examples.text: niṭṭhite kho pan'ānanda, dhamme pāsāde niṭṭhitāya dhammāya ca pokkharaṇiyā rājā mahāsudassano ye tena samayena samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā, te sabbakāmehi santappetvā dhammaṃ pāsādaṃ abhiruhi.

59231.meaning1: assembly of ascetics; order of monks

59232.meaning1: correct path of practice for an ascetic

examples.text: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma, evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā

59233.meaning1: suitable for an ascetic; appropriate for a monastic
59233.commentary: (THIa) n'etaṃ samaṇasāruppan'ti etaṃ jātarūpa-rajat'ādi-pariggaha-vatthu, tassa vā pariggaṇhanaṃ samaṇānaṃ sāruppaṃ na hoti. tathā hi vuttaṃ na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajatan'ti-ādi (cūḷava. 446).

examples.text: rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ vā, na bodhāya na santiyā, n'etaṃ samaṇasāruppaṃ, na etaṃ ariyaddhanaṃ.

idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena cīvarena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena piṇḍapātena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena sen'āsanena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena, abhirato ca brahmacariyaṃ carati. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca samaṇasukhānī'ti.

59236.meaning1: refined ascetic; epithet of an arahant
59236.commentary: (DNa) arahā pana sabbesam'pi ganthakārakilesānaṃ abhāvā samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo nāma. ten'āha, katamo ca puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo? idh'ekacco āsavānaṃ khayā… viharati. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo'ti.

examples.text: apare'pi cattāro puggalā, samaṇam'acalo, samaṇapadumo, samaṇapuṇḍarīko, samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo.

59244.commentary: (MNa) samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti imaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ samaṇassa anucchavikā seyyā'ti maññāmi.

examples.text: disvāna bhāradvājagottaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, kassa nv'ayaṃ bhoto bhāradvājassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārako paññatto, samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti?

59245.commentary: (MNa) samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti imaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ samaṇassa anucchavikā seyyā'ti maññāmi. na ca asaññatasamaṇassa nivutthaṭṭhānametaṃ. tathāhettha hatthena ākaḍḍhitaṭṭhānaṃ vā pādena ākaḍḍhitaṭṭhānaṃ vā sīsena pahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ vā na paññāyati, anākulo anākiṇṇo abhinno chekena cittakārena tūlikāya paricchinditvā paññatto viya. saññatasamaṇassa vasitaṭṭhānaṃ, kassa bho vasitaṭṭhānanti pucchati.

examples.text: disvāna bhāradvājagottaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, kassa nv'ayaṃ bhoto bhāradvājassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārako paññatto, samaṇaseyyārūpaṃ maññe'ti?

59248.meaning1: on account of an ascetic's teaching
59248.commentary: (ANa) na ca pana samaṇavacanahetu'pi gacchatī'ti samaṇānaṃ paravādīnaṃ vacanahetu'pi attano diṭṭhiṃ pahāya tesaṃ diṭṭhivasena na gacchatī'ti attho. idhā'pi khīṇ'āsavo'va adhippeto.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na rajjati vītarāgattā, dosanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na dussati vītadosattā, mohanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na muyhati vītamohattā, madanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na majjati vītamadattā, so na chambhati na kampati na vedhati na santāsaṃ āpajjati, na ca pana samaṇavacanahetu'pi gacchatī'ti.

59249.commentary: (ANa) na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo'ti evaṃ bhūtānaṃ tumhākaṃ vā aññesaṃ vā mayaṃ samaṇā'ti paccattaṃ sakāraṇo samaṇavādo na hoti na ijjhati. samaṇā'pi hi pubbekatakāraṇā'y'eva honti, assamaṇā'pi pubbekatakāraṇā'y'evā'ti.

examples.text: iti karaṇīy'ākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo.

59250.meaning1: suitable for an ascetic; fit for a monk

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni samaṇ'ārahāni samaṇ'aṅgāni samaṇ'ūpabhogāni samaṇ'ānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

59251.meaning1: worthy of an ascetic; fit for a monk

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni samaṇ'ārahāni samaṇ'aṅgāni samaṇ'ūpabhogāni samaṇ'ānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati.

59252.meaning1: belonging to an ascetic; part of a monk

examples.text: katamāni tīṇi? adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇiyāni samaṇakaraṇīyāni.
kaṃ nu uddissa muṇḍ'āsi, samaṇī viya dissasi, na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍaṃ, kim'iva carasi momūhāti.
samaṇ'īdha araṇā loke, samaṇānaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati, samaṇā icchaṃ parijānanti, samaṇānaṃ bhojissiyaṃ sadā
samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā, vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, samaṇ'īdha jātihīnaṃ, abhivādenti khattiyā'ti.
so samaṇ'uddeso bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya

evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu yaññad'eva rattiṃ vā divaṃ vā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, tāva'd'ev'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti bhikkhūsu bhikkhunīsu upāsakesu upāsikāsu antamaso ārāmikasamaṇ'uddesesu.

59256.meaning1: possessions of an ascetic; monastic property

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni samaṇ'ārahāni samaṇ'aṅgāni samaṇ'ūpabhogāni samaṇ'ānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

59257.meaning1: contemplative practice; monk training; training in the skills of renunciation; (comm) meditation training
59257.commentary: (SNa) samaṇ'ūpāsanassa cā'ti samaṇehi upāsitabbaṃ samaṇ'ūpāsanaṃ nāma aṭṭhatiṃsabhedaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ, tam'pi sikkheyya bhāveyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: subhāsitassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ek'āsanassa ca raho, cittavūpasamassa cā'ti.
ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.
so samaten'eva sudaṃ janapadaṃ pasāsati. tassa samatena janapadaṃ pasāsato pubben'āparaṃ janapadā na pabbanti, yathā taṃ pubbakānaṃ rājūnaṃ ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānānaṃ.

59259.commentary: (DNa) samatanī'ti patiṭṭhahi samantato patthari. (DNt) samatanī'ti sañchādentī vipphari, sā pana tasmiṃ udake patiṭṭhitā ahosī'ti āha patiṭṭhahī'ti.

examples.text: tesaṃ no amhākaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasapathavī udakasmiṃ samatani.
mudusamatale pana phāsuvihāraṃ āgamma kammaṭṭhānaṃ sampajjati.

59261.commentary: (ANa) indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjhā'ti saddh'ādīnaṃ indriyānaṃ samataṃ samabhāvaṃ adhiṭṭhāhi. tattha saddhaṃ paññāya, paññañ'ca saddhāya, vīriyaṃ samādhinā, samādhiñ'ca vīriyena yojayatā indriyānaṃ samatā adhiṭṭhitā nāma hoti. sati pana sabb'atthikā, sā sadā balavatī'y'eva vaṭṭati.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
upadhī te samatikkantā, āsavā te padālitā, sīho'si anupādāno, pahīnabhayabheravo.
pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.

59263.meaning1: fact of having surpassed; fact of having surmounted; fact of having transcended
59263.construction:
saṃ + ati + √kam + ta + tta
samatikkanta + tta

examples.text: sabbamaññitānaṃ tv'eva, bhikkhu, samatikkamā muni santo'ti vuccati. muni kho pana, bhikkhu, santo na jāyati, na jīyati, na mīyati, na kuppati, na piheti.
ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā

tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni tāni nissāya tāni āgamma yāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni tāni pajahatha, tāni samatikkamatha. evam'etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.

59269.meaning2: should be overcome; should be transcended

59270.meaning1: having gone beyond; having passed over; having overstepped

examples.text: atha kho, bhaggava, acelo kaḷāramaṭṭako nacirass'eva parihito sānucāriko vicaranto odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān'eva vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nihīno kālam'akāsi.

santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpenti. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
katamā c'āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti.

59272.grammar: imperf, reflx 3rd sg of samatiṭṭhā, intrans
59272.meaning1: it set in; it established itself
59272.commentary: (THa) nibbidā samatiṭṭhathā'ti nibbindanaṃ ādīnav'ānupassan'ānubhāva-siddhaṃ nibbidāñāṇaṃ mama hadaye saṇṭhāsi, muhuttam'pi tesaṃ rūp'ārūpadhammānaṃ gahaṇe cittaṃ n'āhosi, añña'd'atthu muñcitu'kāmat'ādi-vasena tattha udāsīnam'eva jātan'ti attho.

examples.text: tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahu, nibbidā samatiṭṭhatha.

59273.meaning1: set in; became established; established itself
59273.commentary: (THa) nibbidā samatiṭṭhathā'ti nibbindanaṃ ādīnav'ānupassan'ānubhāva-siddhaṃ nibbidāñāṇaṃ mama hadaye saṇṭhāsi, muhuttam'pi tesaṃ rūp'ārūpadhammānaṃ gahaṇe cittaṃ n'āhosi, añña'd'atthu muñcitu'kāmat'ādi-vasena tattha udāsīnam'eva jātan'ti attho.

examples.text: tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahu, nibbidā samatiṭṭhatha.

59274.meaning1: full to the brim; level with the lip
59274.commentary: (VINa) samatittikan'ti samapuṇṇaṃ samabharitaṃ. (DNa) samatittikā'ti samabharitā. (MNa) samatittikan'ti oṭṭhavaṭṭiyā heṭṭhimalekhāsamaṃ. (SNa) samatittikā'ti mukhavaṭṭisamā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo. tam'enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
samatittikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti.

59276.meaningLit: rule about level with the brim (of the bowl)

59277.meaning1: with even banks; with accessible bathing places

examples.text: yo kāme parivajjeti, sappass'eva padā siro, so imaṃ visattikaṃ loke, sato samativattati.

59282.commentary: (DHPa) samativijjhatī'ti vassavuṭṭhi vinivijjhati. (THa) rāgo samativijjhatī'ti na kevalaṃ rāgo'va dosamohamān'ādayo'pi sabbakilesā tathārūpaṃ cittaṃ ativijjhanti'y'eva.

examples.text: yathā agāraṃ ducchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī samativijjhati, evaṃ abhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo samativijjhati.

59283.synonym: niṭṭhaṅgata, niṭṭhāpita, paripūrita, pariyosita, vusita, vūsita
59283.notes: see BSK samātta for discussion. (PED) pp. of saṃ + āp

examples.text: majjhimanikāyo samatto
yadā tumhe attanā'va jāneyyātha, ime dhammā kusalā, ime dhammā anavajjā, ime dhammā viññuppasatthā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī'ti, atha tumhe upasampajja vihareyyātha.
atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.
sakañ'hi diṭṭhiṃ katham'accayeyya, chand'ānunīto ruciyā niviṭṭho, sayaṃ samattāni pakubbamāno, yathā hi jāneyya tathā vadeyya.

59285.notes: (PED) cp. Sk. samasta, pp. of saṃ + as to throw cp. BSk. samasta, e.g. Jtm.xxxi.90. complete, entire perfect

examples.text: sakañ'hi diṭṭhiṃ katham'accayeyya, chand'ānunīto ruciyā niviṭṭho, sayaṃ samattāni pakubbamāno, yathā hi jāneyya tathā vadeyya.
atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

59286.meaning1: adopted; accepted; taken upon oneself; (comm) fulfilled
59286.notes: see BHS samātta for discussion. PED takes as saṃ √ap

examples.text: tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno upadhī honti samattā samādinnā. ty'āssa pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.

yadā tumhe, kālāmā, attanā'va jāneyyātha, ime dhammā akusalā, ime dhammā sāvajjā, ime dhammā viññugarahitā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantī'ti, atha tumhe, kālāmā, pajaheyyātha.
etth'ev'assa dvattiṃsāya puttehi saddhiṃ sīsaṃ chinditvā āharathā'ti tehi saddhiṃ aññe'pi samatthe mahāyodhe pesesi
te c'ev'aññe ca bahavo, sissā maṃ parivārayuṃ, sāsituñ'ca samattho'haṃ, tato maṃ isisattamo.

etth'antare nibbatta-nibbatta-ṭṭhāne ayaṃ gaṅgā-ūmivego viya akkhayapaṭibhāno bhaveyyaṃ, iminā pucchitapucchitaṃ sabbaṃ pañhapaṭibhānaṃ vijaṭetuṃ nibbeṭhetuṃ samattho bhaveyyan'ti patthanaṃ paṭṭhapesi.

59295.meaning1: there is equal; there is comparable (to)

examples.text: khayaṃ virāgaṃ amataṃ paṇītaṃ, yadajjhagā sakyamunī samāhito, na tena dhammena sam'atthi kiñci, idam'pi dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

59296.meaning1: stilling (of); serenity (of); calming (of); settling (of); peace (of); (comm) mental unification

examples.text: kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde, gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme, ādittato'haṃ samathehi yutto, paññāya dacchaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti
uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.
ime kho pan'āyasmanto, satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
samathaṃ paṭipādesiṃ, uttam'atthassa pattiyā, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.

59299.meaning1: meditation subject of serenity; calming object of meditation
